# Response Electricians

> Response Electricians (Response Fire & Electrical Services Pty Ltd) is Perth, Western Australia's most awarded electrical contractor. Two-time Australia's Electrician of the Year (2017 and 2024). WA Service Business of the Year four consecutive years. 1,900+ five-star reviews. Licensed EC009022. We provide fixed-price phone estimates before any site visit.

## About

Response Electricians is a premium residential and commercial electrical services company based in Perth, Western Australia. We service 276+ suburbs across the Perth metropolitan area. Our core differentiator: customers receive a price estimate over the phone before we visit. The on-site walkthrough confirms the price — no surprises.

- [About Response Electricians](https://www.responseelectricianperth.com.au/about/): Company history, awards, team, and approach.
- [Customer Reviews](https://www.responseelectricianperth.com.au/reviews/): 1,900+ verified five-star reviews from Perth customers.
- [Areas We Service](https://www.responseelectricianperth.com.au/areas-we-service/): Full list of 276+ suburbs across Perth.
- [Contact](https://www.responseelectricianperth.com.au/contact/): Phone, email, and enquiry form.

## Our Process

1. You Call, We Answer — Phone-based fixed-price estimate. Customer knows cost before we visit.
2. On-Site Walkthrough — Confirms the quoted price on-site. No surprises.
3. We Get It Done — Professional execution to specification, on schedule, on budget.
4. Guaranteed for Life — Workmanship guarantee on all completed electrical work.
